look_here_first: Bushy upright amaranth with the easiest character in the genus: a pair of sharp spines at nearly every leaf node.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Amaranthaceae/Amaranthus: alternate petiolate leaves and dense clusters of tiny unisexual flowers. Habit, plant sex, hairiness, nodal spines, cluster position, bract/tepal form, and fruit dehiscence are high-value characters.

lookalikes.differences: Paired nodal spines make it nearly immediate. None of the other B114 species routinely has this feature.
